response.sql: WITH station_usage AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall_usage AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(s.mean_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(s.mean_usage - o.mean_usage) AS mean_amount_above_average FROM station_usage AS s CROSS JOIN overall_usage AS o WHERE s.mean_usage > o.mean_usage
